overview: LoginStart is invisible to server-side anticheats: the player entity, world and timing state do not exist yet, and the packet carries only the username. The two corpus hits are packet-library plumbing: FlopAC ChannelHandlerAbstract and intave TinyProtocol both declare the PACKET_LOGIN_IN_START class constant and route it through their channel handlers, and intave's handleLoginStart dispatcher serves the plugin's own cloud-control channel, not a check on the Minecraft login packet. No anticheat flags anything on it.
